paraphrase: Virtue, concentration and wisdom are one path; peace is found by letting go — if you let go a little you have a little peace, a lot, a lot of peace; seeing everything as uncertain ('mai nae') frees the heart from clinging.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
